verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official CLI that manages Feature Gates, Experiments, and Dynamic Configs and can run in CI/CD pipelines to automate them. A probe confirms the official CLI documentation page exists. The evidence is limited to the introductory page, however. missing for 10: details on command coverage, installation and authentication, AI- or agent-oriented features (e.g., machine-readable output), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
